description: Model-intel CLI for local-inference stacks — quants, backend-readiness, vs-current diffs, bench-history, and watch loops, all stack-aware.
auth_description:
Optional. Anonymous read works for all public endpoints. With a token, rate
limits are significantly higher. CLI honors the cached token at
~/.cache/huggingface/token (the path huggingface_hub uses).

novel_features.name: Architecture-feature search
novel_features.description: Search HF for models by architecture feature (mtp, mla, moe, gqa, sliding-window, rope-yarn) — fields HF doesn't index, recovered from config.json + card text.

novel_features.name: vs-current diff
novel_features.description: Diff a candidate model against the model the named agent currently runs, by reading data/openclaw.json directly.

novel_features.name: Backend-readiness oracle
novel_features.description: Verdict whether a model's architecture is supported by a target backend, citing PR numbers, commit SHAs, and wiki notes with source_checked dates.

novel_features.name: Bench-history join
novel_features.description: Join an HF model id with local model-eval-harness results to surface tasks run, scores, vs-baseline delta, and last-run date.

novel_features.name: Eval-candidate emitter
novel_features.description: Emit a list of HF candidates in the model-eval-harness input format directly.

novel_features.name: Watch + agent-notify
novel_features.description: State-file subscription with cron-callable poll; matches emit through the MC API alert pipeline as structured events.

novel_features.name: Quant-variant browser
novel_features.description: Surface GGUF quant variants of a base model with uploader rep, effective size, and quant-type classification — sorted by trusted-uploader allowlist + size filter.

novel_features.name: Multi-runtime probe
novel_features.description: Single-call structured runtime-shape covering TTY, JSON, state writability, live config presence, harness presence, backend-matrix age, rate-limit remaining, HF reachability, proxy presence.
